verdict.rationale: No native bulk-edit or batch endpoint appears in the evidence. Bulk work is only achievable indirectly: GrowthBook documents a full REST API, and its official MCP server makes authenticated REST calls, so an AI agent or script could loop over many flags or experiments. Missing for 10: documented native bulk/batch operations (bulk flag toggles, archiving, or edits), batch API endpoints, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and hands-on evidence of agents running bulk changes.
